The '''Wayland trap''' was orchestrated by [[Darth Maladi]] in order to capture [[Cade Skywalker]] and use him as a test subject for a new creation of hers. Maladi would in turn use her new weapon to help [[Darth Krayt]] regain domination over the [[One Sith]].

==Prelude==
Following [[Cade Skywalker]]'s betrayal of [[Azlyn Rae]] and [[Rawk|Bantha]] and [[Droo Rawk]] on [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]], Skywalker and his crew decided to lay low for a while. Leaving the planet, the [[Mynock/Legends|''Mynock'']] flew to [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]], the homeworld of mechanic [[Deliah Blue]], where [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Jool]], a friend of theirs, had just opened a [[Paradise (cantina)|Paradise]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].

Meanwhile, [[Darth Maladi]] maintained a secret [[Wayland Yuuzhan Vong laboratory|laboratory]] on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]]. Years earlier, the planet was selected as part of the [[Ossus Project]], a massive undertaking orchestrated by the [[New Jedi Order]] to [[Terraforming/Legends|heal]] and restore worlds devastated during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Led by Cade's father, [[Kol Skywalker|Kol]], and [[Master Shaper]] [[Nei Rin]], [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Shaper caste|Shapers]], overseen by Jedi escorts, set to work, and the initial results were wondrous to behold. However, agents of the [[One Sith]], including [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] [[Darth Maladi]] and rogue Yuuzhan Vong shaper [[Zenoc Quah]], secretly [[Vongspawn virus|sabotaged]] the terraforming processes under the orders of [[Darth Krayt]]. Soon on Wayland, the world's lush vegetation underwent mutations of a kind not seen since the Vong forcibly took populations as slaves for shaping. [[Vongspawn|Painful bony growths]] sprouted from the skin of the natives in a plague that affected all the terraformed worlds, bringing the project to a catastrophic end.

Following the death of Darth Krayt [[Battle on Had Abbadon|on]] [[Had Abbadon]], Maladi feared that she would be disposed of by [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]], who had claimed that Krayt was alive but in stasis recovering from his injuries. After sharing her concerns with [[Darth Nihl]] about Wyrrlok, Maladi convinced Nihl to go to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] to confirm Krayt's death, and then, when the truth was discovered, use it as he best saw fit. With Quah's help, Maladi started engineering a new weapon which would help Darth Krayt or his successor gain dominance over the One Sith.
